assertions: Retained build issue reasons, failed test counts, and Sonar condition values remain explicit.
Missing evidence is unavailable; no passing execution is invented.
Shared current Sonar failures retain association limits and both build identities.
Git comparison messages preserve candidate/base direction and unknown counts.
Duplicate test observations are removed without summing counts across builds.
Low coverage alone creates no invented failure threshold.
Failed timeline steps remain visible even when the parent build reports succeeded.
limitations: Pure saved fixture checks only; no external service requests.
Merge-only exceptions are not evaluated by the collected report contract.
These are presentation checks, not release approval.
